name: GraphInstruct
description: GraphInstruct is a progressive-complexity benchmark for diagnosing LLM graph-generation capability. It comprises 800 hand-authored instructions stratified into 6 complexity levels (L0-L5), 1,582 algorithmically synthesized reference solutions, and 4,163 distributional reference graphs (3,115 synthetic L3 + 1,048 real-world L4). Outputs are scored on 5 evaluation dimensions (D1 structural, D2 textual, D3 embedding, D4 instruction-match, D5 efficiency) with deterministic, LLM-as-judge-free metrics. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track submission.
citeAs: @inproceedings{graphinstruct2026, title={GraphInstruct: A Progressive Benchmark for Diagnosing Capability Gaps in LLM Graph Generation}, author={Anonymous Authors}, booktitle={Proceedings of the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Track on Evaluations and Datasets}, year={2026}}

distribution.name: level_0.json
distribution.description: 100 L0 instructions (format generation) with reference solutions and constraint specifications.

distribution.name: level_1.json
distribution.description: 200 L1 instructions (single explicit constraint) with reference solutions.

distribution.name: L3 synthetic reference pool
distribution.description: 3,115 synthetic graphs across 15 attribute subgroups x 3 sizes (small / medium / large).

distribution.name: L4 real-world reference pool
distribution.description: 1,048 real-world graphs across 9 domains (citation, social, biological, infrastructure, communication, ecological, knowledge-graph, plus synthetic BA controls). Each domain subset retains its upstream license; see DATA_LICENSE.md.

recordSet.name: instruction
recordSet.description: One instruction in GraphInstruct: a natural-language graph-generation query with associated constraints and reference solutions.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier in format L{level}-{seq:03d} (e.g., L1-042).

field.name: instruction
field.description: Natural-language instruction issued to the LLM.

field.name: explicit_constraints
field.description: Constraints stated in the instruction text (e.g., graph_type=tree, num_nodes=10).

field.name: implicit_constraints
field.description: Constraints implied by the explicit ones (e.g., a tree with n nodes implies acyclic, connected, n-1 edges).

field.name: graph_sizes
field.description: Size buckets the instruction applies to: subset of {small (<=20), medium (21-50), large (>50)}.

field.name: reference_solutions
field.description: 1 or 2 algorithmically synthesized reference graphs encoded in InstructGraph code-style format.

field.name: feasible
field.description: False for the 9 deliberately infeasible L2 instructions; true otherwise.
